content_sections.heading: About MHI Consultant Grade-II
content_sections.text: The Ministry of Heavy Industries is a ministry of the Government of India. Its HEI Division at GPOA - 3, New Delhi, issued this notice to engage one Consultant Grade-II for specific and time-bound tasks of the Ministry. The work centres on the Electrical Equipment Quality Control Order (QCO) for Low Voltage Switchgears and Controlgears, electrical equipment standardization and trade-related technical matters. The general terms of the engagement are those in the MHI guidelines No.A-45011/9/2019-Admn., dated 27.08.2024, which are attached to the notice.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may apply in the prescribed format (Annexure-I) given with the notice. The notice states that applications shall be sent through email and through the Google Sheet at https://forms.gle/xz1Z3TPiGA56gUgz9 . The email addresses printed in the notice are: [email protected] – Director (HEI) [email protected] – Deputy Secretary (HEI-Technical) [email protected] – Under Secretary (HEI) The Annexure-I form asks for: name, date of birth, father's name, nationality, address for communication, permanent address, phone number, email address, educational qualification (course, subject, university/institute, year of passing, marks %) and post-qualification work experience (organisation name and contact details for verification, period from and to, post held, job responsibilities, reason for leaving), with a recent photo, the candidate's signature, date and place.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The vacancy is for one Consultant Grade-II, engaged on contract basis. The notice prints no category-wise break-up. Essential: B. Tech in Electrical / Electronics Engineering (EEE/ECE/EE) or any other branch or equivalent stream from a reputed and Govt. recognized Institution. Desirable: PhD/M. Tech in Electrical / Electronic's Engineering (EEE/ECE/EE) /MBA or equivalent stream from a reputed and Govt. recognized Institution. Minimum of 8 (Eight) years post essential qualification experience relevant to the job description. Preference will be given to persons with sufficient domain knowledge and experience in the implementation of Technical Regulations / Quality Control Orders (QCO) and Electrical Industry Sector / Public Policy domain / International Trade Related matters, monitoring of projects & schemes etc. Under the attached MHI guidelines, experience includes up to 3 years for a Ph.D. holder, provided no work experience is counted during those 3 years. Candidates should be below 50 years of age as on 1 October 2026. The attached MHI guidelines state that in the case of a retired Government servant, the ceiling of age limit may be relaxed. Retired Government servants who fulfil the eligibility criteria with requisite experience in the relevant sector/field can also participate through the competitive process in line with rule 177 of GFR, 2017. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The remuneration is Rs.1,45,000/- per month, released as a consolidated amount on the basis of biometric attendance or certification by the Division. The yearly enhancement in remuneration may be as follows: The total enhancement in remuneration shall not exceed 10% in any case. The attached guidelines add that the remuneration of a Consultant shall in no case exceed 1.20 times the initial remuneration. For a retired Government servant, remuneration is a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at retirement, with no annual increment during the contract. The Consultant is not entitled to allowances such as TA/DA, CCA, HRA, CGHS, Medical Reimbursement or any other relief. For approved domestic official tours, a Consultant Grade-2 may travel by air in economy class or by rail in AC Two Tier, with hotel accommodation of up to Rs.4500/- per day, AC taxi up to 50 Kms within the city and food bills not exceeding Rs.1000/- per day.

content_sections.heading: MHI Consultant Grade-II Job Description
content_sections.text: Oversee and manage all activities related to the implementation of the Electrical Equipment Quality Control Order (QCO) for Low Voltage Switchgears and Controlgears. Coordinate with industry stakeholders, BIS, testing labs, departments/ministries and other agencies to ensure effective implementation of regulations and policies. Participate, examine and prepare inputs/proposals for BIS Sectoral Committees for electrical equipment standardization. Prepare comprehensive procedures for clarifying QCO product classifications with customs. Examine and prepare proposals or suggest initiatives to address and mitigate the impacts of supply chain constraints. Develop concept notes for initiatives aimed at enhancing the electrical equipment sector. Formulate and evaluate public policy for the electrical equipment industry, including examining draft cabinet notes, policies, schemes, FDI proposals and the registration of bidders under GFR 144(XI). Examine and prepare inputs/proposals related to Technical Barriers to Trade or Non-Tariff Measures for Free Trade Agreements (FTA), Preferential Trade Agreements (PTA) and WTO TBT negotiations for the Department of Commerce (DoC) and DPIIT. Technical examination of Cabinet Notes/EFC/PIB/DIB of all matters except clean technology. Technical examination of Concept Note/Feasibility Report/Bills/Acts/MoU, etc. of all matters except clean technology.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MHI Recruitment 2026 for Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) vacancy for Consultant Grade-II in the Ministry of Heavy Industries, HEI Division.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MHI Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement on the MHI website, which is about 17 November 2026 (15 days from 2 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for MHI Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: A B. Tech in Electrical / Electronics Engineering (EEE/ECE/EE) or any other branch or equivalent stream from a reputed and Govt. recognized Institution is essential.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: A minimum of 8 (Eight) years post essential qualification experience relevant to the job description is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MHI Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: Candidates should be below 50 years of age as on 1 October 2026; the ceiling may be relaxed for retired Government servants under the MHI guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of MHI Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.1,45,000/- per month, with a possible yearly enhancement of up to 10% based on performance.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for MHI Consultant Grade-II?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-I form and send it by email to [email protected], [email protected] and [email protected], and also through the Google Sheet link given in the notice.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Short-listed candidates who meet the qualification/experience criteria will be called for interview through online or offline mode.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MHI Consultant Grade-II job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is on contract basis for an initial 02 (Two) years, extendable by up to 01 (One) more year based on yearly performance evaluation.

faq.question: Q10. Will HRA or other allowances be paid with the salary?
faq.answer: No, the Consultant is not entitled to TA/DA, CCA, HRA, CGHS or Medical Reimbursement; only approved official tour expenses are reimbursed.
